source.title: Domostroj
source.editorial-note: All supralinear letters are taken down. Text subjected to a number of corrections.
source.annotator: Rebecka Lindberg (1710 sentences), Katie Sykes (118 sentences), Aleksandrs Berdicevskis (55 sentences), Marek Majer (17 sentences), and Hanne Eckhoff (3 sentences)
source.reviewer: Katie Sykes (1842 sentences), Hanne Eckhoff (36 sentences), Marek Majer (19 sentences), and Aleksandrs Berdicevskis (3 sentences)
source.electronic-text-version: Enriched version of the electronic text found at http://lib.pushkinskijdom.ru/Default.aspx?tabid=5145, which is an edition of the 16th century manuscript RNB, Q. XVII. 149 (Konšinskij spisok). The orthography is substantially corrected (de-simplified) after A.S. Orlov (ed.) (1908): Domostroj po Konšinskomu spisku i podobnym, Moscow: Sinodal’naja tipografija. Diacritics are omitted, the i-a ligature rendered as я, the o-u ligature rendered as ѹ.
source.electronic-text-publisher: DFG project “Corpus Linguistics and Diachronic Syntax”, principal investigator: Professor Roland Meyer, see Meyer, Roland (2012): The Construction and Application of Diachronic Slavonic Corpora in Linguistic Research – RRuDi (Russian) and PolDi (Polish). In: Hansen, B. (Hg.): Diachrone Aspekte slavischer Sprachen. (= Slavolinguistica 16), München/Berlin: Verlag Otto Sagner, 223-242.
